title: 双语感悟：野餐
cue: Describe a picnic / an outdoor meal.
a:
准备这道题的好处是可以和另一道题 Describe a special meal. 一起解决了。但是 Pat 发现有中国同学们普遍不了解描述野餐需要的英文词汇，其实 native speakers 在说野餐时的用词并不“野”。下面是一些最常用的“野餐用语”：

更加接近大自然 get closer to nature（过去时：got closer to nature）
享受自然的美景 enjoy natural beauty（过去时：enjoyed natural beauty）
景色 scenery（注意：它是不可数名词）
家庭聚会 a family gathering / a family get-together
几家人聚餐 a potluck（一般是每家都带些吃的，大家一起 share）
公园里的野餐桌 picnic table
长椅 bench
小板凳儿 small stool
春天和秋天野餐时铺在地上用的毯子 picnic blanket（夏天则常用 plaid sheet “格子布”代替）
铺开 spread out
背包 backpack
纸盘 / 纸杯 paper plate / paper cup
筷子 chopsticks
叉子 forks
刀 knife
勺子 spoons
装食品和餐具的篮子 picnic basket（在国外野餐时必带，考官听到会觉得很亲切）
烧烤 have a barbecue（barbecue 既可以做名词也可以做动词）
烧烤用的原料 barbecue ingredients（常见的有 chicken，lamb，shrimp 等）
调味酱 sauce
沙拉 salad
甜点 dessert（比如 cakes 和 biscuits）（注意：它的发音和沙漠 desert 不一样）
水果 fruit（比如 strawberries 和 grapes）
瓶装水 bottled water
果汁 juice
垃圾袋 garbage bag
拍照片 take photos（过去时是 took photos）
给自己拍照片，“玩自拍” take selfies（过去时是 took selfies）
玩游戏 play games（过去时是 played games）
一次令人难忘的经历 a memorable experience

再加你看到的景色和对自己感受的描述，肯定够两分钟了……

title: 双语感悟：一个被污染的地方
cue: Describe a place that has been affected by pollution.
a:
IELTS 口试里有时会考 Describe a place that has been affected by pollution. 这道题。

最容易说的是噪音污染。比如一个原来很安静的地方，因为在那附近盖了机场（an airport was built just a few kilometers away from that area），变成了很吵的地方（became a very noisy place），当地居民深受噪音的折磨（local people have suffered a lot from the noise），晚上睡不好觉（can't sleep well at night），当地的学生们也经常被噪音干扰注意力（are often distracted by the noise）等等。

另一种容易说的污染是来自工厂的污染。比如一个地方以前很干净，河水非常清澈（crystal-clear），后来在附近盖了一个化工厂（a chemical plant），向当地的河里倾倒大量的污水（It has discharged tons of waste water into the local river），而且持续排放有毒的气体（It has been releasing poisonous gases into the air.），导致河水被严重污染（the river was seriously polluted），在当地经常会看到雾霾（We can often see a layer of smog over the area.）。

当然，污染也未必是这样大规模的，如果想说旧塑料袋（used plastic bags）和一次性的泡沫塑料午餐盒（disposable foam lunch boxes）被乱扔（were scattered all over the place）而导致的污染也同样是扣题的答案。

title: 游戏之 捉迷藏
a:
As a child, I often played hide-and-seek with my friends. We usually played this game in a park or in a building with many rooms.

The game was played like this：one of us, called the “seeker”, searched around for the “hiders”. The game started with the seeker covering his or her eyes and counting to 100, while everyone else ran away and found a place to hide.

After the counting was finished, the seeker opened his or her eyes and started searching for the hiders, which was my favourite part of the game. The hiders tried their best to keep quiet. But then, there was always someone who got caught, and this person would be the next seeker.

I really enjoyed this game because it was simple but exciting, and it helped to make us more active. These days, my friends and I tend to have fun by sitting around and playing computer games, which, honestly, can be quite unhealthy. Sometimes I really miss the simple pleasure of playing hide-and-seek.
vocab: help to make us more active
提高孩子的平衡和协调能力
